paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: comparison by language family.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of task counts across different language families, as indicated by the horizontal axis labeled "IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, Uralic." The vertical axis, labeled "task count," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick labels displayed at 10-unit intervals. The chart presents data for three models: mBERT, XLM-R, and "same," each represented by a different color – dark blue for mBERT, green for XLM-R, and light green for "same." The bars are grouped, with each language family having three bars representing the three models side-by-side, facilitating visual comparison. The shortest bars, with a task count approximately equal to 2, are associated with the "same" model for the "IE-Germanic" and "Semitic" language families. The tallest bar, with a task count of roughly 34, corresponds to the mBERT model evaluated on the "IE-Slavic" language family.  The bars are not sorted in any particular order based on the task count or language family. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or other special formatting.
